m: Om. I worship the sovereign of the worlds, shining like the young sun, her crown the moon, her breasts high, joined with three eyes,
her face smiling, her hands holding the boon, the goad, the noose, and the gesture of fearlessness. Om. The seer said:

When the great lord of the asuras had been slain there by the Goddess, the gods, with Indra, and with fire at their head, praised Katyayani. From obtaining what they desired, their hopes opened like a lotus that had opened its face.

Goddess, remover of the pain of those who have come for refuge, be gracious. Be gracious, Mother of the whole world. Be gracious, sovereign of the universe. Protect the universe. You are the sovereign, Goddess, of what moves and what does not move.
You alone are the support of the world, since you abide in the form of the earth. By you, abiding in the form of the waters, all this is nourished, O you of unconquerable valour.

You are the Vaishnavi power, of unending valour. You are the seed of the universe. You are the supreme illusion. All this is bewildered, Goddess. You yourself, when gracious, are the cause of liberation on earth.

All knowledges are your distinctions, Goddess. All women in all the worlds are your distinctions. By you alone, Mother, this has been filled. What praise of you can there be, a speech that would be higher than what is to be praised?
When you, Goddess, are all beings, the giver of enjoyment and of liberation, and you are the one praised, what can become a praise? Let the highest utterances be.
You who abide in the heart of every person in the form of understanding, giver of heaven and of release, Goddess, Narayani, salutation to you.
You who give change in the form of the parts of time, beginning with the kala and the kashtha, power at the cessation of the universe, Narayani, salutation to you.
Auspiciousness of all that is auspicious, Shiva, accomplisher of every aim, worthy of refuge, three-eyed, Gauri, Narayani, salutation to you.
Eternal, you who have become the power of creation, continuance, and destruction, resting-place of the qualities, consisting of the qualities, Narayani, salutation to you.
Intent on protecting the afflicted and the suffering who have come for refuge, Goddess, remover of the pain of all, Narayani, salutation to you.
Seated in a chariot yoked with swans, bearing the form of Brahmani, sprinkling the water of Kusha grass, Goddess, Narayani, salutation to you.
Bearer of trident, moon, and serpent, whose mount is the great bull, in the form of Maheshvari, Narayani, salutation to you.
Surrounded by peacock and cock, bearer of a great spear, faultless one, established in the form of Kaumari, Narayani, salutation to you.
You who have taken up the excellent weapons of conch, discus, mace, and sharnga bow, be gracious in the form of Vaishnavi, Narayani, salutation to you.
You who have taken up a fierce great discus, who lifted the earth with your fang, whose form is the boar, auspicious one, Narayani, salutation to you.
You who in the fierce form of the man-lion set out to slay the daityas, joined with the protection of the three worlds, Narayani, salutation to you.
Crowned one, great thunderbolt, shining with a thousand eyes, taker of Vritra's life, Aindri, Narayani, salutation to you.
In the form of Shivaduti, you of great strength who slew the daityas, of terrible form, of great roar, Narayani, salutation to you.
You whose mouth gapes with fangs, adorned with a garland of heads, Chamunda, crusher of Munda, Narayani, salutation to you.
Lakshmi, modesty, great knowledge, faith, nourishment, svadha, the fixed one, great night, great illusion, Narayani, salutation to you.
Intelligence, Sarasvati, the excellent, prosperity, Babhravi, she of tamas, the restrained one, be gracious, sovereign. Narayani, salutation to you.
Form of all, sovereign of all, joined with every power, protect us from fears, Goddess. Durga, Goddess, salutation to you.
May this gentle face of yours, adorned with three eyes, protect us from all beings. Katyayani, salutation to you.
May the trident, gaping with flame, exceedingly fierce, destroyer of all the asuras, protect us from fear. Bhadrakali, salutation to you.
May that bell, which destroys the splendours of the daityas and which fills the world with its sound, protect us, Goddess, from sins, as a mother her children.
Your hand shines, smeared with the blood, fat, and mire of the asuras. May the sword be for what is auspicious, Chandika. We have bowed to you.

When pleased you remove all diseases. When angered you take away all desired wishes. No calamity comes to those who have taken refuge in you. Those who have taken refuge in you go on to become a refuge themselves.
This slaughter that you have made today, Goddess, of the great asuras who hate dharma, making yourself many-formed in many ways, Ambika: who else does that?

In the sciences, in the scriptures, in the lamps of discernment, and in the primordial utterances, who other than you is there? You whirl this universe exceedingly in the very great darkness of the pit of mine.

Where there are rakshasas and serpents of fierce poison, where there are enemies and bands of robbers, where there is a forest fire, and in the midst of the ocean, there you stand and protect the universe.

Sovereign of the universe, you protect the universe. Consisting of the universe, you hold the universe here. Those who are bowed in devotion to you, and who are the refuge of the universe, become worthy of the praise of the lords of the universe.

Goddess, be gracious. Protect us, who fear the enemy, always, just as now, at once, from the slaying of the asuras. Quickly lead to quiet the sins of all the worlds, and the great afflictions born of the ripening of portents.
Be gracious to those who have bowed, Goddess, remover of the pain of the universe. Praised by those who dwell in the three worlds, be the giver of boons to the worlds.
The Goddess said:
I am the giver of boons, hosts of gods. Choose the boon that you desire in your minds. I give what is a benefit to the worlds.
The gods said:
Sovereign of the whole triple world, the quieting of every affliction, and the destruction of our enemies, should be done by you in this very way.
The Goddess said:
When the interval of Vaivasvata has come, in the twenty-eighth age, Shumbha and Nishumbha, two other great asuras, will be born.
Born in the house of the cowherd Nanda, come forth from Yashoda's womb, I will then destroy those two, dwelling on the Vindhya mountain.
Again, descending to the surface of the earth in an exceedingly fierce form, I will slay the danavas who are the sons of Viprachitti.
And as I devour those fierce great asuras, the sons of Viprachitti, my teeth will become red, like the flower of the pomegranate.
Then the gods in heaven, and human beings in the mortal world, praising me, will always call me Raktadantika.
Further, in a drought of a hundred years, when there is no water, remembered by the sages, I will come into being on the earth, not born of a womb.
Then I will look upon the sages with a hundred eyes. Human beings will then celebrate me as Shatakshi.
Then, O gods, I will fill the whole world with vegetables born from my own body, which hold life until the rain returns.
I will then become famed on earth as Shakambhari. And in that very place I will slay the great asura named Durgama.
My name will then become famed as the Goddess Durga. And again, when I take a terrible form on the snow mountain,
I will devour rakshasas for the protection of the sages. Then all the sages, their bodies bowed, will praise me.
My name will then become famed as the Goddess Bhima. When the one named Aruna will make a great affliction in the three worlds,
then, taking the form of a bee, of innumerable six-footed ones, I will slay that great asura for the welfare of the three worlds.
And the worlds will then praise me on every side as Bhramari. Whenever an affliction born of danavas arises in this way,
then I will descend and destroy the enemies.
